latest_release.name: v3.20.257-lts
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Auto-start trial for new users by @Siddharthpl in https://github.com/ToolJet/ToolJet/pull/18828
* Fix: Keep manually enabled Public Apps after plan renewal by @Siddharthpl in https://github.com/ToolJet/ToolJet/pull/18935
* Feature: Land new users on the home page prompt after onboarding by @shah21 in https://github.com/ToolJet/ToolJet/pull/18961
* Auto trial bug fixes by @Siddharthpl in https://github.com/ToolJet/ToolJet/pull/18975
* Update first-user onboarding Cypress spec for home-page landing by @ajith-k-v in https://github.com/ToolJet/ToolJet/pull/18976
* Release v3.20.256 lts by @gsmithun4 in https://github.com/ToolJet/ToolJet/pull/18945


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ToolJet/ToolJet/compare/v3.20.256-lts...v3.20.257-lts
